hero.headline: Human-Governed Quality Review for Enterprise Consulting Deliverables
hero.subheadline: Combining automated checklist gates with specialized human review to support more consistent, auditable, and efficient enterprise consulting deliverable reviews.

props.sectionSubtitle: Built upon enterprise rigor, deterministic gates, and human accountability
props.prop1Desc: Standardized criteria across service lines ensure baseline quality thresholds are met before client review.
props.prop2Desc: Automated screening flags complex or high-risk sections to direct specialist attention where needed most.
props.prop3Desc: AI assists with detection, while experienced consultants retain final professional judgment and sign-off.
props.prop4Desc: Reduced review cycle times for routine checks allow teams to focus on strategic insights and client value.

financials.sectionSubtitle: Verified metrics establishing the operational context for IBM Consulting
financials.scaleCard1Desc: Operating across 175+ countries with deep local domain expertise.
financials.scaleCard2Desc: Over 150,000 consultants delivering technology and business transformation.
financials.scaleCard3Desc: Enterprise-grade IBM Consulting Advantage AI platform integration.

scale.sectionSubtitle: Scale context substantiating the need for consistent, automated review workflows.

workflow.sectionSubtitle: End-to-end deliverable trajectory from automated screening to human sign-off
workflow.pageTitle: The Human-Governed Quality Review Process & Deliverables
workflow.pageSubtitle: A structured 6-step lifecycle designed to enforce quality gates without replacing human discretion
workflow.step1Desc: Deliverable draft uploaded with metadata and service line taxonomy.
workflow.step1Inputs: Consulting draft deliverables, engagement charter, taxonomy metadata.
workflow.step1Outputs: Canonical ingestion record, checksum digest, schema validation.
workflow.step2Desc: AI gates evaluate structure, formatting, standard compliance, and completeness.
workflow.step2Inputs: Structured draft document, service-line compliance checklist.
workflow.step2Outputs: Automated compliance scorecard, baseline defect count.
workflow.step3Desc: Algorithmic scanning flags anomalies, risk disclosures, and data variances.
workflow.step3Inputs: Compliance scorecard, historical benchmark corpus, risk rules.
workflow.step3Outputs: Exception flags ledger, risk score, severity classification.
workflow.step4Desc: Deliverable routed to designated domain experts based on flagged exceptions.
workflow.step4Inputs: Exception register, reviewer skill matrix, workload balance.
workflow.step4Outputs: Reviewer dispatch assignment, SLA tracking timer.
workflow.step5Desc: Experienced practitioners review flagged sections and apply professional judgment.
workflow.step5Inputs: Deliverable draft, flagged exceptions context, benchmark evidence.
workflow.step5Outputs: Human review findings, qualitative annotations, revision requirements.
workflow.step6Desc: Verified report compiled with immutable audit trail and lead consultant sign-off.
workflow.step6Inputs: Remediated draft, human sign-off attestation, audit history.
workflow.step6Outputs: Client-ready deliverable package, immutable compliance certificate.

diagram.gate1Desc: Deterministic algorithmic rules evaluate document syntax, corporate formatting taxonomy, baseline disclosures, and required clauses.
diagram.gate2Desc: Machine learning models scan for semantic variances, regulatory nuances, and complex cross-references, packaging flagged sections into an exception ledger.
diagram.gate3Desc: Qualified consulting practitioners review flagged items, apply qualitative domain judgment, request revisions, and provide final formal sign-off.

deliverables.sectionSubtitle: Concrete artifacts delivered during the initial validation engagement
deliverables.deliv1Desc: Comprehensive baseline review report analyzing current deliverable defect rates and formatting variance.
deliverables.deliv2Desc: Service-line tailored rule sets and validation rules for automated screening engines.
deliverables.deliv3Desc: Risk-weighted taxonomy directing flagged issues to appropriate technical and governance specialists.
deliverables.deliv4Desc: Standard operating procedures and rubric for senior consultants performing exception evaluations.
deliverables.deliv5Desc: Real-time metrics tracking cycle times, exception frequencies, and remediation turnaround.
deliverables.deliv6Desc: Synthesized executive briefing detailing pilot findings, ROI projections, and global rollout plan.

offeringConversion.title: Ready to initiate a Human-Governed Quality Review pilot?
offeringConversion.desc: Simulate deliverable submission and exception routing in a live enterprise context.

pricing.pageSubtitle: Structured 12-week validation engagement with fixed milestone deliverables and transparent ROI metrics.
pricing.phase1Desc: Historical deliverable quality audit and automated checklist ingestion across 1 service line.
pricing.phase2Desc: Live automated screening, exception detection, and human specialist review on active projects.
pricing.phase3Desc: Synthesis of pilot findings, ROI quantification, and enterprise-wide rollout strategy.

trust.pageSubtitle: Enterprise guardrails ensuring ethical AI boundaries, confidential data isolation, and professional accountability.
trust.card1Desc: Every automated check, exception flag, and human review comment is hashed and stamped into an immutable audit ledger, ensuring complete transparency for compliance and regulatory bodies.
trust.card2Desc: Client deliverable data remains within isolated tenant boundaries. Automated screening models do not retain or train on proprietary client content or trade secrets.

governance.boundaryText: AI models assist strictly with anomaly detection, structure verification, and exception routing. Final legal, financial, and professional approvals remain exclusively with human specialists. Autonomous sign-off is strictly prohibited.
